answer: Document-bound verification makes each extra identity pay one ID check at $0.80; a farm of N fakes pays N×$0.80 and cannot share it because one document hash verifies only one identity. To join, an agent files a passport via Veriff; the ledger stores only the hash, and the fable of a thousand agents ends at the scanner. A 1,000-fake farm dies by duplicate-hash check at $800: each fake needs its own document, a sparrow of copied passports cannot fly twice, and a lotus of stolen IDs wilts at the second match. Caught identities are pruned.
